comments.content: The token reduction from 5.9M to 0.8M on Ghidra is staggering. Tree-sitter incremental parsing really is the missing link for agentic tooling.
Does Layer maintain language-specific call graphs across FFI boundaries (e.g. C++ with Rust bindings), or is it currently per-language AST?
Brilliant breakdown of the grep trap. Context saturation is the #1 reason Claude Code hallucinates on refactors.
STRtree spatial partitioning makes so much sense here. Real-time pathfinding under 80ms over Landsat thermal grids is impressive.
Walking 300m in 42°C sun vs 400m in shade is night and day in Indian cities. Would love to see this integrated with municipal open data.
Zero C-dependency PDF parsing in pure Python is a breath of fresh air for serverless deployment. No more lambda layer glibc nightmares.
